build.buildCommand: cd client-admin && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../client-resident && npm ci && tsc -b && npx vite build --base /resident/ && cd ../client-shelter && npm ci && tsc -b && npx vite build --base /shelter/ && cd ../server && npx prisma generate && npm run build && mkdir -p public && cp -r ../client-admin/dist public/client-admin && cp -r ../client-resident/dist public/client-resident && cp -r ../client-shelter/dist public/client-shelter

deploy.startCommand: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy; node dist/index.js
